If I were ruler of the world, my first priority would be to ensure the fundamental human needs are met for all people. This would involve redundant systems and self-sustaining infrastructure to adequately supply people with food, water, and shelter, not only in times of peace but also pandemics and other disasters.
My second priority would be to protect the environment and prevent environmental degradation, focusing on climate change as one of the most critical issues, and allocating resources toward long-term, sustainable solutions.
Additionally, I would invest in simplifying access to learning and education for all people, focusing on creating open-source libraries, testing creative experimental teaching methods, and iiiven free resources relating to all fields.
Given the unpredictable nature of the world, I would also focus on creating permanent liberties and freedom in all regions of the globe, such as religious freedom, freedom of speech, and freedom of assembly, through universally accessible and transparent governance.
